exposure: Alcohol or drug abuse during pregnancy
outcome: Spontaneous first trimester miscarriage rates per woman
cohort: The study included 53,479 parous women admitted to labor and delivery wards at Hadassah Medical Centers in Jerusalem, Israel, between 2004 and 2014.
finding: 43% of parous women reported experiencing one or more first trimester spontaneous miscarriages, with rates increasing with age, parity, previous ectopic pregnancy, previous cesarean surgery, smoking during pregnancy, and pre-pregnancy BMI >=30.
mod_finding: First trimester miscarriage rates rose after a previous cesarean surgery.
